visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene is set in a dimly lit, stylish restaurant or bar with red-tinted ambient lighting. A woman wearing a blue, provocative police-themed cosplay outfit with a short skirt, necktie, and hat enters from the left background. She walks towards a brushed metal table in the foreground while carrying a black bowl filled with noodles. (2) As she reaches the table, she leans over, exposing her upper body. As she attempts to place the bowl, the noodles slide out and spill across the metal surface. Her expression shifts to wide-eyed shock, and she frantically uses her black-gloved hands to try and gather the loose noodles back into the bowl while looking down. (3) She stops her movements and looks directly into the camera lens. Her face is made up with theatrical smudged lipstick and red marks to appear slightly disheveled. She maintains a fixed, exaggeratedly sad and pouty expression as the camera lingers on her face and the mess on the table.
